coefficient.formula: K=(0.05 m / 1.4) * fx_pixels, CoC diameter in pixels

training.h2_overlap: arithmetic mean, active only inside M
training.gate_collapse: Report extrema; halt for exact whole-domain zero or one at two consecutive phase-two checks

schedule.encoder: frozen Depth Anything V2 Small, layers 2/5/8/11 zero-based
schedule.coordinates: window in native pixel-edge coordinates; level pixel center x+0.5 and align_corners=False

tear_retraining.selection: Minimize mean holdout weighted edge error and false-step tear rate; then weighted edge error and earliest step.

scheme_A.fitted_value: raw mu_b before front/back clipping; detach a and g for this term
scheme_A.objective: Sum of the gap, normal and boundary masked pixel means; rod contributes zero.
scheme_A.rho2_rear_residual: 1.5 * tanh(h1), independent of a and g
scheme_A.semantics: Single-surface rear targets use the v3 order constraint in gap, normal and boundary. The single-rear term omits rod pixels. The dual-surface term retains the v3 support.

selection.metric: Equal mean of the rod, gap, boundary and normal zone pixel means of 25.4 * abs(decoded rho - GT center rho), in px.
selection.boundary: For a boundary prediction at p, take the minimum error against valid ground truth at q in the 3x3 window about p.
selection.rod_gate: Holdout rod absolute decoded-error p50 <= 1.00 * OVG rho1 rod-error p50.
selection.fallback: Minimum rod p50, then earlier step if tied.

evaluation.success: G F2 and S2 each have paired median >= 0 dB and pooled PSNR >= B.

correction.text: 两条规则均选中 v4@1k；该点选后分量比例为 0%，开发集 P/G 远焦 F2 = 23.91/31.28，与 OVG（23.89/31.26）一致。原成功标准只看 G 对焦且只和 B 比，OVG 本身即可满足，因此不能作为 E 有效的依据。v4 在 2k 以 1.03 倍未过细杆门槛，2k–4k 的细杆倍数与 v3 趋势相近（v2 同期约 0.97/0.98），说明 2k–4k 的细杆退化并不由杆区单层监督单独解释。推测来自方案 A 的其余部分（非杆区单层监督或去掉 a、g），未分开验证。
correction.reporting_standard: P、G 分别报告 F2、S2 对 OVG 和 B 的逐场景配对中位、变好／变差场景数及合并 PSNR。正式 E 交由规划方与用户决定。
correction.note: The historical result.success records its original narrow rule. The correction governs interpretation.

sources.OVG_and_B: 3e135e5 E-query all-case rows; A uses OVG + v2a tear. B uses v1@2k + matched tear.
sources.v2: E2_2k_tear in E0-v3 record, per-case E_B_learned in E2_2k; F2/S2 reused. Query and Query-inclusive zero evaluated with the adopted checkpoint.
sources.v4: E0 v4 step-002000 with newly trained matched tear head

source.geometry: A of 3e135e5, OVG with the original v2a tear
source.focus: E P distances transferred to A. Same observed F2 and S2/S0 geometry and placement as A.

focus_transfer.largest_error_rule: Rank scenes by their largest |P_E−GT| over the recorded far frames; report the inverse-distance difference on that same frame.

no_tear_input.source: Existing native pixel renders reused where retained; otherwise exact no-tear replay
no_tear_input.masks: Identical native GT region masks for all geometry arms; paired union equals each arm's GT mask on matched frames.

regional.share_definition: Native pixel RGB SSE in each region divided by total far-recoverable RGB SSE on the same matched case set. The four GT loss zones and the single/dual partition are separately reported. Pixels outside valid GT are unclassified.

single_branch.assumptions: Extrapolate the serial 1a 500-step benchmark. 1b has no matched single-branch trace; budget the observed concurrent branch wall time without an assumed speedup.

crossfit_scope.folds: Group by original B scene, including every observation/optical derivative. Train matching 1a/1b step counts excluding the fold's B scenes. Reuse independent non-B tiers. Run fold-external OVG on each excluded scene once across all folds. The 15 development scenes stay external.
crossfit_scope.cache_assumptions: Full-frame encoder tokens are independent of OVG and reusable. Native inputs and E-H2 windows depend on OVG, so estimate their new footprint from current measured training-frame volumes. Window counts can change after retraining. No duplicate full data copies per fold.
crossfit_scope.timing: One RTX 5090, folds sequential, cache timings scaled from measured wall time including minor CPU work. Training benchmarks had optical production active; folded training schedules are estimates.

ovg_cost.cache_fields: rho1/inverse1, rho2/inverse2 and phi_full from frozen OVG. RGB, prior inverse depths and confidence are observed inputs, with attenuation recomputed from them; E computes its own mixture and gate.

2k 候选: dev003 的三个 2k 候选在同一放大块上都保留竖杆，G 下的轮廓差较小。Query 与 S2 的隐藏颜色差主要出现在几条竖杆轮廓上。
dev005 的 OVG 自身对焦将杆渲染得窄且亮，三个 2k 候选在 P 下都更接近 Cycles 的散焦宽度。统一 G 后，四臂的杆宽差收窄，隐藏颜色差仍沿底部横杆出现。
dev008 的三个 2k 候选在 F2 下都保留船下小物体的较清楚轮廓。换 S2 时该处更柔和。Query 与 S2 的隐藏颜色差集中在船体外沿和下缘小物体边界。
组合臂: dev003 的 OVG P 栏杆较锐。交入 E 的焦距后，末列横杆和竖杆的模糊宽度更接近图里的 E P。
dev005 的 OVG P 有很亮、很窄的绿色杆；只换成 E 的对焦距离后，杆变宽、饱和度下降，靠近 Cycles 图。
dev008 的 E P 在船体下方露出较清楚的小物体轮廓。OVG 换用同一焦距后，小物体仍较糊，可用 F2/S2 两对行同时查看。
区域误差: dev003 放大处的评分像素沿竖杆边缘成窄线，v4@8k 有一根比 OVG 和 v4@2k 更亮的长条。
dev005 的竖杆与底部横杆交会处，各学习臂仍有细条状误差。GT 列在同一放大块中多数竖线更暗。
dev008 的误差沿船体轮廓和下缘小物体出现。v4@8k 的船体右端边缘比 v4@2k 更亮，GT 列的下缘小物体误差更暗。
dev010 所示放大块的评分支持集中在底边一条很窄的横带。图中大部分灰区在评分掩码外。
dev011 的误差沿斜线下缘分布。v4@8k 在右侧出现更亮的局部斑点，GT 的热条更细。
训练与交叉拟合: 图中的 5 折总 GPU 时间接近 2 折的 2.5 倍。每帧只保存一次折外输入，两个预算的缓存盘占都接近 154 GiB。
